newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Budapest shares end lower in ongoing bearish trend.
newsitem.headline: Budapest shares end lower in ongoing bearish trend.

text.p: Hungarian share prices closed lower on the Budapest Stock Exchange (BSE) on Monday in what traders called dull trading without major client orders.
The BUX index closed at 3,525.39 points, down 20.63, matching trends on the Warsaw bourse. Spot share turnover totalled 797.9 million forints.
BUX index futures closed weaker for five maturities, by 16.00 to 40.00 points and remained steady for December 1997.
With Monday's price falls the bourse extended its losses to finish the sixth successive day lower, traders said, but added that they expected the downward trend to bottom out soon.
"This was still part of the correction," said Balazs Szabo of Eastbrokers. "The index may fall another 10 to 15 points but I expect the market to begin to firm slightly afterwards."
The BSE's six-day long corrective phase saw the BUX index plummet 203.19 points from the all-time high of 3,728.58 points reached on October 17.

Plastics industrial Pannonplast was unable to reverse the trend despite the release of what traders called this morning excellent January-September results. In slack turnover Pannonplast shares slipped 50 forints to end at 5,050.
